items.title: 61521_David Albert Francis oral history interview
items.q: right after I joined the band, Sister Thärpe came with us

ctx.x: So that's when I started working at

the Savoy with Lucky, and right after I joined the band, Sister Thärpe came with us -- she had just left the Cotton Club with Cab Calloway, and she joined us, I guess, well, I think that Moe Gale had her signed up at the time, and so he put her with the band.

She was singing the gospel music with a jazz band, and we -- made the Panorama, remember when President Roosevelt's son had this thing, it was like the forerunner of TV -- you put a dime in and you saw a picture of the band and the music and the dancers and all this ...
